latest.title: What Happens When Your AI Agent Goes Rogue? Building Guardrails for Autonomous AI on AWS
latest.description: AI agents can execute tools, access APIs, and make decisions autonomously, but what happens when they make the wrong decision? Explore how to design secure AI agent systems on AWS using least-privilege IAM, permission boundaries, human approval workflows, monitoring, and controlled execution environments.

latest.title: Evaluating an Enterprise IT Support Agent with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
latest.description: Learn how I evaluate enterprise AI agents using Amazon Bedrock, Strands Agents, and AgentCore Evaluations to validate tool accuracy, security compliance, and task completion.

latest.title: Amazon S3: A Beginner’s Guide to Scalable and Secure Cloud Storage
latest.description: Explore Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3), AWS's scalable object storage service. This beginner-friendly guide explains buckets, objects, storage classes, versioning, lifecycle management, and security features, with practical examples of how organizations store and manage data in the cloud.

latest.title: I Turned On Bedrock Prompt Caching. My Bill Went Up.
latest.description: 32 real requests in eu-west-1, four ways to place one cachePoint, and two silent failures no error message will ever show you.

latest.title: I Built cdkd: Deploy Your Existing AWS CDK Code Up to 15x Faster
latest.description: cdkd is an OSS CLI that deploys CDK apps directly through the AWS SDK instead of CloudFormation, with no changes to your code, and also runs Lambda, API Gateway, and ECS locally on Docker. This post covers benchmarks against CloudFormation (including Express mode) and Terraform, how hybrid provisioning and dependency-graph parallel execution work, and two-way migration with CloudFormation, plus installation, quick start, and a Skill for AI coding agents.

latest.title: Getting Started with AWS: A Beginner's Guide to Cloud Computing
latest.description: Learn the fundamentals of cloud computing, understand Amazon Web Services (AWS), explore its important services, and discover how beginners can start building applications in the cloud.

latest.title: AWS Cost Optimization: How to Build Efficient Cloud Infrastructure Without Overspending
latest.description: Explore practical strategies to reduce cloud expenses while maintaining performance, reliability, and scalability. Learn how to monitor AWS spending, optimize infrastructure, manage storage efficiently, and build cost-aware cloud environments using AWS tools and best practices.

latest.title: The Cloud That Thinks Ahead: What If AWS Could Predict Failures Before They Happen?
latest.description: What if your AWS infrastructure could predict failures before they happen? Explore how Amazon CloudWatch, AWS CloudTrail, AWS Config, and Amazon Bedrock could work together to detect risks, predict infrastructure failures, recommend preventive actions, and enable intelligent recovery. Discover the future of AI-powered cloud operations, where systems move beyond monitoring and become proactive, resilient, and intelligent. **Don't just monitor your cloud. Make your cloud think ahead.

latest.title: How AI Is Revolutionizing Traffic Management in Smart Cities
latest.description: Discover how Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning are transforming urban transportation through intelligent traffic signals, congestion prediction, accident detection, and real-time traffic monitoring. Explore how AWS cloud technologies support smarter and safer cities.
